releases.name: The Walking Trade
releases.summary:
The Walking Trade is a quirky, action-packed zombie apocalypse store management game where chaos and commerce collide!

Design your shop, balancing space, aesthetics, and functionality. Organize shelves, set prices, and ensure customers leave happy - or at least alive.

Customers aren’t your only problem - zombies invade! Wield melee weapons, firearms, or whatever you can find to defend your shop during raids and hordes.

Hire survivors to scavenge supplies, serve customers, or guard the shop. Keep them equipped and motivated to reap the rewards.

releases.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
releases.summary: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

releases.name: A Difficult Game About Letters
releases.summary: Transform into letters to overcome platforming challenges and save your friend from evil King in this crayon-style adventure!

releases.name: Omni Growth
releases.summary: The last hope of your species. Consume your prey, evolve, and turn an abandoned galactic ship into your personal hunting grounds as you become a deadly predator.

releases.name: Shardwatch Dominion
releases.summary:
Shardwatch Dominion is a classic top-down tower defense game set in circular arenas. You protect a central fortress and its glowing crystals from waves of enemies that attack from every direction.

Every decision matters: where you build, what you spend crystals on, and which upgrades you take between waves. Placement and resource management decide whether the fortress holds.

releases.name: Vixen 357
releases.summary:
This Sci-fi simulation game is based on exciting story with various events and unique characters and epic battles with dozens of units. Year of 2396.

The high-mobility armored trooper "Vector," secretly developed to replace the former main weapon, "SERD."

One day, a mysterious unit attacked the base of Slash Unit, who had been training to become the pilots of Vectors. But who are they…?

Now, the battle begins again, with the secrets lie hidden!

This Sci-fi simulation game is based on exciting story with various events and unique characters and epic battles with dozens of units.

16 different levels of pure tactical strategy.

Features:

• Strategic Freedom: Assign any VECTOR to any character.

• Permadeath: Mistakes are permanent. Command wisely.

• Narrative Decisions: Trust no one. Learn the truth through survival.

* Gallery: view images from the original game’s illustrations, posters, box design, etc.

* Rewind/Turbo function: repeat something until you achieve perfection, or speed things up

* Cheats function: activate cheats that will make your mission a lot easier (infinite lives, invulnerability, etc.)

* Save state function: save wherever you want to in the game, and restart from that exact point

* Screen filters: select from several filters to modify how the game looks (retro-style monitor, black-and-white, etc.)

releases.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
releases.summary:
War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches a full-scale invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4. A young squad of South Korean soldiers fight to survive on the collapsing front lines, while half a world away a vengeful Captain Price wages a personal war from the shadows as he stays one step ahead of those hunting him. As Price’s off-book mission collides with the forces behind the invasion, the war spreads beyond anyone’s control. Modern Warfare® 4 pushes the series into darker and more dangerous territory, where consequence and escalation bring long-running storylines to a powerful and emotional breaking point.

- Campaign drops players into trench warfare in Korea, close-quarters combat in New York, high-octane chases through Paris, SAS night raids in Mumbai, and city-wide assaults to reclaim occupied territory.
- Multiplayer delivers grounded, precise combat where fluid movement, player choice, and greater control define every engagement.
- In DMZ, players operate as an off-the-books asset behind enemy lines, where every extraction run into contested territory forces hard choices about which objectives to pursue, what to secure, and when to get out.

releases.name: Gaelco Sports Collection
releases.summary:
Get ready for the ultimate 90s arcade rush. This collection brings back 5 legendary, lightning-fast hits developed by the arcade masters at Gaelco. Forget complex simulations; here, it’s all about raw reflexes, immediate fun, and high-speed challenges that defined a generation of cabinet gaming.

Drive at breakneck speeds in the cult-classic isometric racers World Rally Championship and World Rally 2, where every corner requires perfect drifts against a brutal 60-second timer.

Conquer treacherous slopes in Snowboard Championship, execute precise racket strikes in Squash, and dominate the sand with fierce smashes in Touch and Go.

It’s a pure dopamine rush straight from the golden age of arcades.

releases.name: Final Kick Football Legends
releases.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

releases.name: Back to the Dawn
releases.summary: In Back to the Dawn, you play a reporter caught up in a dark conspiracy and who got thrown into a maximum-security prison for not playing ball. Gather your wits and learn how to survive in this hostile environment. Explore every inch of the prison and exploit any weakness you find. Make friends (or foes) with your fellow inmates and with their help, break out of prison. It's not just your life you are saving, but the entire city!

releases.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
releases.summary: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

releases.name: Tidy Up the Flower Shop
releases.summary: The grand opening is tomorrow, and someone has helpfully unpacked the entire delivery onto the floor. Pick the flowers up an armful at a time, sort them by species into baskets, paint them in patterns, and have the place ready by morning. No timers, nobody watching. A cozy first-person tidy-up.

releases.name: Demons' Night Fever
releases.summary:
Based on classic grid-based strategy games, this entirely new SRPG features the Peon Exploitation System - a brutal combat mechanic where you mercilessly sacrifice your own allies.

The more misdeeds you commit, the more vicious your army becomes, and the greater your advantage in battle!

Regain the lost power of the Devil, Giga Super Death, who was transformed into a baby, and crush the false god wearing a mask of justice!

releases.name: Moadra
releases.summary: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

releases.name: Ace Driver: Victory Lap
releases.summary:
"ACE DRIVER VICTORY LAP" is a racing game released by NAMCO LIMITED (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1996.
The hit arcade racer ACE DRIVER returns with more speed, more excitement, and more competition than ever before!
Race across brand-new tracks, experience fully redesigned machines, and take on thrilling high-impact courses.
With authentic handling and enhanced gameplay, every lap delivers fast-paced arcade racing at its best.
Get behind the wheel and experience the next evolution of ACE DRIVER!

releases.name: The Raiden Project
releases.summary: Two great arcade faves hit home... right where it hurts! When aliens invade Earth, you fly an awesome experimental plane into fierce battles to save the world. It's the ULTIMATE airborne "dodge 'n destroy" challenge. You'll probably end up in traction!

releases.name: Playground VR
releases.summary: Playground VR It is an open-world game where you can experience the beautiful essence of VR. Do you want to fly a balloon? Fly! Are you not afraid to be cured of cannon? Launch yourself! Do you want to take to the sea waves? Swim! Do you want to climb the building? Free way! Yes, you can do it all!

releases.name: Entwined: Strings of Deception
releases.summary: Uncover a dark scheme in Entwined: Strings of Deception and solve an elaborate murder mystery! Play the role of detective Karla Robbins and interview the different suspects of a grisly murder. Search the Edward family mansion and question the late Christopher Edward's wife, butler, housemaid, and even his physician in this incredible Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game. Find the murderer and discover their motive in Entwined: Strings of Deception!

releases.name: PAPERHEAD
releases.summary: In the cute cardboard world, something went horribly wrong... Use the magical pencil, a good old shotgun, and various other weapons as well as the strength of your mighty boots, to uncover the dark truth and find out WHY WOULD CARDBOARD... BLEED?

releases.name: Cotton Reboot!
releases.summary:
Japan's favorite shooter mascot finally gets a worldwide release as a beautiful HD game with stunning graphics and remixed soundtracks. 

This is the original "Cute em' up", and will test your skills as well as tug on the heartstrings as Cotton and her friends are finally back in the ultimate celebration of one of Japan's most beloved gaming mascots. Choose between the HD Reboot mode or go legit with the X68000 original mode with pixel perfect graphics from the iconic Japanese home computer.

releases.name: PEAK
releases.summary: PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK? Climb through 4 biomes on your way to the PEAK, each with their own life-threatening obstacles. You’ll need to scavenge for questionable food to survive, and manage your injuries carefully - every setback limits your stamina, making it harder to climb. The game's map rotates out every 24 hours! Try out the new layout each day, or give the same island multiple attempts in a day until you conquer it.

releases.name: Cotton Reboot! High Tension!
releases.summary:
The sequel to "Cotton Reboot!" released in 2021 is here! Will the gluttonous witch Nata de Cotton be in action again this time?

Enjoy this even more powerful and refreshing witchy shooter!
